description: Retired Moonshot AI high-speed offer for the legacy Kimi K2 turbo model slugs. Current high-speed access is exposed by the direct Moonshot AI provider as a priority service tier; inactive ordinary-model records are preserved only as historical discovery observations.
residency_notes: Moonshot's Kimi OpenPlatform policy says it is controlled from Singapore, stores information on secure Singapore servers, and may transfer data cross-border. Account, input, and payment information are retained while the account is active, and user content may be used to optimize or improve the service; no Zero Data Retention control is documented.
prompt_training_notes: Moonshot says user content helps optimize its models and that content may be used to provide, maintain, develop, and improve the services.

sources.notes: The turbo offer uses the same official Moonshot Chat endpoint and authentication contract.

verification.notes: The legacy K2 turbo slugs were discontinued on 25 May 2026. Current K2.7 Code HighSpeed access is represented as Moonshot AI's priority service tier instead of this retired provider offer.
